description: Frontend climate risk dashboard with React/Next.js components, Leaflet map visualization, Recharts graphs, mitigation checklist, and error handling with retry
steps: 1. Create frontend/src/components/ClimateRiskDashboard.tsx: Import React hooks (useState, useEffect), FleetRiskMap, RiskDistributionChart, MeterRiskDetail. Define DashboardState type (fleetSummary, selectedMeterId, loading, error, retryCount). Implement component that fetches from /api/climate-risk/fleet on mount, handles loading/error states with retry button (increments retryCount), displays error banner with bg-red-100 border-red-400, renders metrics summary cards, RiskDistributionChart, FleetRiskMap with onMeterSelect callback, conditionally renders MeterRiskDetail modal when selectedMeterId is set.

2. Create frontend/src/components/FleetRiskMap.tsx: Import react-leaflet (MapContainer, TileLayer, Marker, Popup), leaflet types. Define FleetRiskMapProps type. Implement component that renders Leaflet map centered on fleet centroid, creates markers for each meter color-coded by insuranceTier (low=green, moderate=yellow, high=orange, critical=red), adds click handler that calls onMeterSelect(meterId), shows meter ID and risk score in popup.

3. Create frontend/src/components/RiskDistributionChart.tsx: Import Recharts (PieChart, Pie, Cell, Tooltip, Legend). Define props type with riskDistribution object. Implement component that renders pie chart with 4 slices (low, moderate, high, critical) using Recharts, colors match map marker colors, tooltip shows count and percentage, legend displays tier names.

4. Create frontend/src/components/MeterRiskDetail.tsx: Import React hooks, ScenarioComparisonChart, MitigationList, InsuranceTierBadge. Define props (meterId, onClose). Implement modal overlay with semi-transparent backdrop (bg-black bg-opacity-50), modal content with white bg and rounded corners, close button (X) in top-right, ESC key handler, backdrop click handler. On mount fetch /api/climate-risk/assess/:meterId and /api/climate-risk/scenarios/:meterId, display loading spinner, show error if fetch fails, render meter ID, InsuranceTierBadge, overall risk score, ScenarioComparisonChart, MitigationList.

5. Create frontend/src/components/ScenarioComparisonChart.tsx: Import Recharts (BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, Legend, CartesianGrid). Define props with scenarios array. Implement component that renders grouped bar chart with X-axis=scenario name, Y-axis=risk score (0-100), three bars per scenario (flood=blue, heatwave=red, storm=purple), tooltip shows exact values, responsive container.

6. Create frontend/src/components/MitigationList.tsx: Import React hooks. Define props (plans array, onUpdate callback). Implement component that sorts plans by priority (critical>high>medium>low), renders each as list item with priority badge (critical=red, high=orange, medium=yellow, low=gray), hazard icon (🌊 flood, 🌡️ heatwave, ⛈️ storm), recommendation text, cost estimate (format as USD), status dropdown (pending/planned/in_progress/completed) that calls onUpdate on change. Show completed items collapsed by default with expand button.

7. Create frontend/src/components/InsuranceTierBadge.tsx: Define props (tier: string). Implement component that renders styled span badge with tier text, color-coded background (low=green-100/text-green-800, moderate=yellow-100/text-yellow-800, high=orange-100/text-orange-800, critical=red-100/text-red-800), rounded padding, bold font.

8. Update MeterRiskDetail.tsx to implement PATCH /api/climate-risk/mitigation/:mitigationId when user changes status in MitigationList, handle API errors with toast notification or inline error message, optimistic UI update then revert on error.

9. Add ClimateRiskDashboard to main frontend navigation or create new page in frontend/src/app/climate-risk/page.tsx (Next.js 14 app directory) that renders <ClimateRiskDashboard />. Ensure leaflet CSS imported ('leaflet/dist/leaflet.css') in layout or page.
acceptance_criteria: ClimateRiskDashboard component fetches fleet data, displays loading/error states with retry functionality
FleetRiskMap renders Leaflet map with color-coded meter markers by insurance tier
Clicking meter marker opens MeterRiskDetail modal with scenario comparison chart and mitigation list
ScenarioComparisonChart uses Recharts to visualize flood/heatwave/storm scores per scenario
MitigationList allows status updates via dropdown, sends PATCH request to backend
Modal closes on ESC key, backdrop click, or X button click
All components use Tailwind CSS classes for styling consistent with existing frontend
Frontend builds without errors: cd frontend && npm run build
verification: cd frontend && npm run build - compiles without errors
Check frontend/src/components/ contains all 7 new component files
Manually test in dev mode: npm run dev, navigate to climate risk dashboard, verify map renders, click meter marker opens modal
Verify error handling: disconnect backend, click retry button, check error banner displays
